explanation: ZTF20aclwctm: 116 detections across 7 calendar years at a near-constant amplitude (MAD/median < 0.15) --- a fixed subtraction residual, not a transient

queries.gaia_cone: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, phot_variable_flag, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 268.6620531, 12.4522752)) * 3600.0 AS sep_arcsec_2016 FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 268.6620531, 12.4522752, 0.01666667))
queries.simbad: SELECT main_id, otype, sp_type, ra, dec, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 268.6620970, 12.4523458)) * 3600.0 AS sep_arcsec FROM basic WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 268.6620970, 12.4523458, 0.00834880))
queries.vsx: SELECT * FROM "B/vsx/vsx" WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', RAJ2000, DEJ2000), CIRCLE('ICRS', 268.6620970, 12.4523458, 0.00834880))
